message: feat(reload): preserve logical ownership across content replacement and reparenting

edits:
## Stage 1: logical ownership edits

Content-host child insertion, deletion and replacement, including the application's content root, now preserve the host. Named controls and whole existing subtrees can move between existing supported panels/content hosts in one document/namescope. Explicit `Children`, `Content`, and `Child` property elements are supported. Inherited context and enabled state are refreshed after moves; source bindings keep their original target identity and change context. The runtime preflights ownership, rejects cycles, preserves trailing C# children and refuses to overwrite application-owned content.

Regression paths: `tests/tree-ownership-reload.test.js` and two additional browser tests in `tests/browser/test_development.py`. Local checks: 222 Node tests, 15 development-browser tests, build and syntax checks. Local Chromium uses the self-contained offline document because HTTP navigation is blocked in the execution environment; hosted CI exercises HTTP.

Moves into newly constructed hosts, extracting retained descendants from removed hosts, cross-document/namescope moves, and templated hosts remain explicit restart cases. The application instance itself is not replaced; content-root replacement is distinct from changing its C# type.

def test_reparent_between_panel_and_content_host_preserves_input(self):
        text=self.source('MainView.axaml')
        text=text.replace('  </StackPanel>','    <Border Name="Target" />\n  </StackPanel>')
        self.page.locator('#editor').fill(text);self.page.click('#dev-restart')
        expect(self.page.locator('#dev-tree')).to_contain_text('#Target',timeout=30000)
        frame=self.page.frames[-1];identity=frame.evaluate('appHandle.root.Input.uid')
        self.preview.get_by_role('textbox').fill('reparented input')
        self.page.check('#dev-hot')
        child=next(x for x in text.splitlines(True) if '<TextBox' in x)
        moved=text.replace(child,'').replace('<Border Name="Target" />','<Border Name="Target">'+child+'</Border>')
        self.page.locator('#editor').fill(moved);self.page.click('#run')
        expect(self.page.locator('#dev-status')).to_contain_text('Hot reload 1',timeout=30000)
        self.assertEqual(frame.evaluate('appHandle.root.Target.Content.uid'),identity)
        self.assertTrue(frame.evaluate('appHandle.root.Input.parent===appHandle.root.Target'))
        expect(self.preview.get_by_role('textbox')).to_have_value('reparented input')
        self.page.locator('#editor').fill(text);self.page.click('#run')
        expect(self.page.locator('#dev-status')).to_contain_text('Hot reload 2',timeout=30000)
        self.assertTrue(frame.evaluate('appHandle.root.Input.parent===appHandle.root.Panel'))
        self.assertIsNone(frame.evaluate('appHandle.root.Target.Content'))
        self.assertEqual(self.errors,[])
    def test_content_replacement_keeps_existing_host_and_disposes_old_child(self):
        text=self.source('MainView.axaml').replace('  </StackPanel>','    <Border Name="Target"><TextBlock Name="OldChild" Text="old"/></Border>\n  </StackPanel>')
        self.page.locator('#editor').fill(text);self.page.click('#dev-restart')
        expect(self.page.locator('#dev-tree')).to_contain_text('#Target',timeout=30000)
        frame=self.page.frames[-1];identity=frame.evaluate('appHandle.root.Target.uid')
        frame.evaluate('globalThis.oldChild=appHandle.root.OldChild')
        self.page.check('#dev-hot')
        self.page.locator('#editor').fill(text.replace('<TextBlock Name="OldChild" Text="old"/>','<Button Name="NewChild" Content="replacement" Click="Increment"/>'));self.page.click('#run')
        expect(self.page.locator('#dev-status')).to_contain_text('Hot reload 1',timeout=30000)
        self.preview.get_by_role('button',name='replacement',exact=True).click()
        expect(self.preview.get_by_text('Count: 1',exact=True)).to_be_visible()
        self.assertEqual(frame.evaluate('appHandle.root.Target.uid'),identity)
        self.assertTrue(frame.evaluate('oldChild._disposed'))
        self.assertIsNone(frame.evaluate("appHandle.root.FindControl('OldChild')"))
        self.assertEqual(self.errors,[])

test('content-host child deletion is compatible and releases its old visual',()=>{const f=fixture('<Border Name="Border"><TextBlock Text="A"/></Border>'),old=f.root.Border.Content;reload(f,'<Border Name="Border"/>');assert.equal(f.root.Border.Content,null);assert.equal(old._disposed,true);f.root.Dispose();});
